text_block_list.text:
One day, while I was working in the 
Trainer's Office...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, regarding this weekend, please 
keep your schedule open.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"This is the perfect time for a short 
break. We should get some rest soon."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Don't forget to submit your leave request 
either.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'll have to get going soon.

Narita Brian pulled a crumpled piece of 
paper from her pocket.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: To the hot springs.
And so, a few days later.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Oho. This is quite something. The scent of 
tatami isn't bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If I take a photo and send it to Mom, 
she's sure to be awfully jealous.
choice_data_list:
Are you sure I was the right person to 
invite?

Are you sure I was the right person to 
invite?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Why bring that up now? The travel voucher 
itself was originally part of your reward 
anyway."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading back to my room soon. Make 
yourself at home.
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oh, there you are.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Looks like dinner is being served in the 
hall over there. You're eating too, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Alright, shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...And with that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Just as I wondered why my nose felt 
unusually breezy, I realized the tape was 
peeling off.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go swap this out for a new one. 
I'll catch right up, so go ahead and start 
eating.
choice_data_list:
Since we have the chance, let's go 
together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Then let's hurry.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Found it... And that makes it the last 
one.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haha, looks like that mountain of tape you 
gave me finally ran dry.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, it's been nearly two 
years since the Asahi Hai FS. I suppose 
that's only natural.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Two years—no, three years since making her 
debut, was it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...I never thought it would last this 
long."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. You never make a bad choice. I'd 
really appreciate it if you could.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Until a new roll of tape is ready, I'll 
just put a bandage on it and wait.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I won't feel settled without it anyway. 
It's only a temporary fix for a while, so—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text: *hic*... *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Mmh. Are you still crying, Brian? Tumbling 
over once is no reason to be pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text: B-But my nose is stinging, y'know...

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Man, you're hopeless~. ...Come here. I'll 
lend you a magic bandage that makes you 
totally invincible."

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
Invincible...? Can I get stronger than a 
ghost?

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"You can do it, you can! Trust your big 
sis! All right... and stick!"

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...How is it, Brian?

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
Amazing, amazing! It doesn't hurt at all 
anymore! I'm seriously invincible now!

text_block_list.name: Young Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Hey, Big Sis. Can you put this on 
me again tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Haha, got it. Keep in mind this is just 
first aid, though. Let's make sure Mom 
checks it out properly later, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Ever since then, I've always...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Trainer. Apparently, I've been the 
"Invincible Brian" since way back then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's right... Alright, let's go 
get some food.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I've applied the new tape, too. That 
should be everything—nothing left behind.

During dinner, Narita Brian was unusually 
talkative, making for a lively 
conversation.

When I brought up her older sister, Biwa 
Hayahide, she happily shared some fond 
memories with me.

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond between myself and 
Narita Brian...
